map.基于 sql.js (WebAssembly) 在浏览器内存中运行完整 SQLi: Runs a full SQLite engine in browser memory via sql.js (WebAssembly), supporting multiple SQL statements, result tables, execution time, history, and database export. All data is processed locally and never uploaded.
map.在浏览器中直接执行 SQL 语句。: Execute SQL statements directly in the browser.
map.：基于编译为 WebAssembly 的 SQLite 引擎，完全在浏览器内运行: : Based on a SQLite engine compiled to WebAssembly, running entirely in the browser.
map.：数据只存在于本地内存，不会上传到任何服务器。: : Data exists only in local memory and is never uploaded to any server.
map.：支持标准 SQL 语法与 SQLite 内置函数，可建表、插入与查询。: : Supports standard SQL syntax and SQLite built-in functions; you can create tables, insert, and query.
map.：页面刷新后数据即丢失，重要结果需及时导出保存。: : Data is lost on page refresh; export important results promptly.
map.当前数据库中的表（点击表名快速查询前 100 行）: Tables in the current database (click a table name to quickly query its first 100 rows)
map.暂无数据表，执行 CREATE TABLE 语句后此处会显示。: No tables yet; this area shows after you run a CREATE TABLE statement.
map.验证一段查询逻辑：不用起数据库服务，直接在浏览器里建表、插数据、跑 SQL，快速: Validate a query: no database server needed—create tables, insert data, and run SQL right in the browser to quickly confirm the result matches expectations.
map.可，运行于内存库，刷新即清空。: Yes, in an in-memory database that clears on refresh.
map.不会。运行在浏览器内存（或临时库）中，刷新页面即丢失，且不上传任何内容——这是它: No. It runs in browser memory (or a temporary database); data is lost on refresh and nothing is uploaded—which is exactly why it suits temporary validation and teaching demos, but it cannot be used as persistent storage. To keep results, manually export SQL or CSV.
map.SQLite 在线执行工具基于 sql.js（将 SQLite 编译为 WebA: The SQLite Online Runner is built on sql.js (SQLite compiled to WebAssembly) and runs a complete SQLite engine in browser memory. No software install or account needed—open the page, write and run SQL, and see results in real time. All data is processed locally and never uploaded.
map.基于 WebAssembly 的完整 SQLite 引擎: Complete SQLite engine based on WebAssembly

map.SELECT 结果以表格形式展示: SELECT results shown as a table
map.显示执行耗时与影响行数: Shows execution time and affected rows
